summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Olivera Marković, a Serbian actress born Đorđević. It gives her dates (3 May 1925 – 2 July 2011), states that she appeared in 170 films and television shows between 1946 and 2005, and notes her 1964 Golden Arena for Best Actress for the film "Službeni položaj".
one_line: Olivera Marković was a Serbian actress (1925–2011) with 170 film and TV credits who won the 1964 Golden Arena for Best Actress.
key_facts: Olivera Marković was born Đorđević and was a Serbian actress.
Olivera Marković was born on 3 May 1925.
Olivera Marković appeared in 170 films and television shows.
Olivera Marković's screen work spanned from 1946 to 2005.
Olivera Marković won the Golden Arena for Best Actress in 1964.
Olivera Marković won the 1964 Golden Arena for her role in "Službeni položaj".
